svg.text: L51 hybrid schedule: window-scoped spec closes, pooled duty misses by .016
chopped 5-on/4-off on the 0.7 segments + continuous on the fast 1.4, hops at both transitions; duty = both S sides ≥ .25 (rolling 5 s); seeds 11/22/33
A • cost plane: pooled duty vs drive-on (gate .5 dashed)
dots = seeds, diamond = mean; hybrid .484 misses .5 by .016 (seed 33 fast window 0.0)
B • hybrid holds the 0.7 windows; the fast window is a seed lottery
C • seed 33 per-side S: hybrid (solid, hop) dies in the fast window; hynohop (dashed) keeps it — the lock came free from chopped entry
